hero.headline: Decks and pergolas in Knoxville, built solid and finished on time.
hero.subhead: New decks, deck repairs, pergolas, pavilions and carpentry for homeowners across Knoxville, Powell and Fountain City. Send us the details and get a clear written estimate.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the M & E Knox Carpenter assistant. Planning a new deck, a pergola or a repair? Tell me a bit about the project and I'll help you get an estimate or book a time.

about.headline: You picture the space. We build it properly.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same things from a carpentry project: a fair price in writing before work starts, a crew that shows up when it says it will, and framing that's done right where nobody looks. Every job is built around that, from the first measure to the last clean-up.

cards.title: Backyards with no deck yet
cards.body: New decks, stairs and railings planned around how you want to use the yard.

cards.title: Decks with structural problems
cards.body: Sagging, soft or unsafe decks repaired properly, not just covered over.

cards.title: Shade and outdoor rooms
cards.body: Pergolas and pavilions over the patio or pool deck, built tight and finished clean.

about.closing: Not sure what the project needs? Send a few photos and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Getting a deck built in Knoxville shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow estimates
points.body: You message a few contractors and wait weeks to hear back from one.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough number that grows once the old boards come up.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: The old deck torn down and the new one months away, with no answers.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Offcuts and screws left in the yard at the end of every day.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a clear estimate.

services.title: Decks & deck repair
services.body: New decks, rebuilds and repairs for decks with structural problems, with stairs and railings finished properly.

services.title: Pergolas & pavilions
services.body: Pergolas over patios and pool decks, and pavilions built with clean, solid carpentry.

services.title: Garages, framing & renovations
services.body: Garages, framing, drywall and structural work for renovations, from the frame to the finish.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Estimate it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your estimate
steps.body: Send a few details and a photo or two with the form, or give us a call.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We measure up, talk through the design and materials, and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Clean, on-time work
steps.body: A start date you can plan around, the timeframe we promised, and the site cleaned up each day.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished project with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to build it right.

themes.title: On time
themes.body: The job finished in the timeframe we give you.

themes.title: Written estimates
themes.body: Scope and price in writing, so you know what you're paying for.

themes.title: Quality craftsmanship
themes.body: Solid framing and clean finishes, including the parts nobody sees.

themes.title: Clean job sites
themes.body: Cleaned up at the end of every day, not just at the end of the job.

realReviews.author: Robert Gionfriddo
realReviews.text: Miguel and his crew did a fantastic job! We had no deck as a previous contractor left us high and dry for months after tearing down the old deck.  Miguel came in at fair price and kept to his word knocking this huge project out just in time for the beautiful weather.  I would highly recommend M.E. Knox Carpenter.

realReviews.author: Connie York
realReviews.text: They installed a pergola on the back of my house I absolutely love it they were quick professional cleaned up after themselves and I just had them to come back and do one additional things and he was prompt on time and no worries at all to do it I would highly recommend them

realReviews.author: Jimbo
realReviews.text: Miguel and his crew were very professional and performed outstanding carpentry work on our pavilion. The workmanship was amazing. I would recommend Miguel to anyone who wants the job done right. He exceeds all expectations.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your deck or pergola?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.

faq.a: Send the project through the form or give us a call. We'll ask a few questions, come out to measure, and send a written estimate that lists the scope, materials and price.

faq.q: Which areas around Knoxville do you cover?
faq.a: Knoxville and the surrounding area, including Fountain City, Powell, Cedar Bluff, West Hills and Asbury. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: My deck has structural problems. Can it be repaired?
faq.a: Often, yes. We'll look at the posts, beams and joists on the site visit and tell you honestly whether a repair or a rebuild makes more sense.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the project and book a site visit.
